I can remove that. Quick clarifying questions before I cancel (calendar changes are visible to others):

1) Do you mean the recurring "Design Critique" meeting at Wednesdays 16:00?  
2) Do you want to cancel:
   - a) the next single occurrence,  
   - b) this and all future occurrences, or  
   - c) the entire series (past & future)?  
3) Should I notify attendees when I cancel? (yes/no)  
4) Confirm timezone if it’s not your calendar default.

Reply with your choices (e.g., “Yes — cancel entire series and notify attendees; use my default timezone”) and I’ll cancel it.
